findings: The current public ds_analytics_run takes finite numeric matrices/parameters and returns JSON bytes; ds_analytics_free releases them. UTF-8 labels, report styles, binary files and artifact bytes require an explicit additional ABI/SQL design.
Inspected dispatcher/registry and tracked analytics Rust/C++ code have no dedicated generic chart renderer or PPTX/GIF/report/journal/notebook serialization stack.
Existing kernels are bounded precursors. No runtime/build tests were run in this acceptance audit, and no artifact was validated as implemented.

shared_output_acceptance.renderer: CPU layout/plotting with explicit axes/scales, grouping/facets/series identity, labels/legends, dimensions and missing/hidden/excluded semantics. Human-readable artifact plus inspectable plot data is required.
shared_output_acceptance.errors: Stable rejection of malformed/nonfinite/unsupported specifications. Never silently substitute a different plot, model, algorithm or file format. Document public ABI/SQL invalid/NULL behavior.
shared_output_acceptance.reproducibility: Persist input/formula/parameter/style/seed/format provenance. Validate with independent parsers and representative rendered inspection.
shared_output_acceptance.runtime: The implemented feature must run through the public C ABI and actual loaded DuckDB SQL, not only a detached Python/CLI wrapper.

open_research: Distribution count-SE formula is image-based; inspect its equation before full histogram-error parity.
Detailed JMP interpolation/tie convention is not specified by overview; retain as an explicit implementation detail.
JMP uses OpenGL. GPU navigation is excluded; CPU geometry/static export is required.
Equation images need direct extraction; between-within sigma and defect-contour formulas need additional detailed references.
Full Nelson/nonnormal rules and alert limit estimation still need detailed Process Screening contracts.
Existing balanced crossed Gauge R&R is a bounded precursor, not all chart/model variants.
Combined-cause thresholds and per-unit options require detailed Pareto pages.
Native journal/script compatibility is separate from neutral diagram/table output.
Catalogue locates this under Factor Analysis; explicit diagram controls are documented under SEM. Loadings alone do not close it.
Automatic tick/bin choice and shadowgram sequence require explicit detailed conventions.
Extract JMP quantile interpolation convention; generic host quantiles are not evidence of box-plot parity.
Density/smoother choices require detailed platform options. A correlation matrix alone is insufficient.
A single simple bar is partial; the documented style catalogue remains required.
Hex assignment and size scaling need explicit conventions.
Related control-chart kernels are not a dedicated run-chart artifact implementation.
Bounded state-space kernels do not establish JMP automatic smoothing-family selection.

Exact aggregation/interpolation rules need detailed launch/platform documentation.

Native -Name.jmp/-XY.jmp interoperability and CRS treatment remain separate unverified contracts; plain XY input is insufficient.
